text:
lina: rolled out a small canary for the 'adaptive-prefetch + shortpath' policy in us-west-2 at 11:12 PT. rule: inputs <=90 tokens use shortpath-quant with top-64 prefix prefetch.

tarun: quick snapshot?

lina: canary (6% traffic, 11:12-11:40): requests 6.9k, p50 14ms -> 9ms (-36%), p95 220ms -> 140ms (-36%), p99 520ms -> 360ms (-31%). estimated token-cost per 1k tokens -19%. errors unchanged.

mo: nice improvement. did eval catch any regressions on short Q&A prompts?

lina: ran short-qaeval (2k samples) + synthetic code checks. automated metrics stable; two narrow issues on precise currency/math formatting where quantization trimmed trailing zeros. added bypass: if prompt matches /\b\d+[.,]?\d*\s*(USD|EUR|GBP)\b/ or contains math tokens, route to full-precision model.

deploy-bot: rollout: route-manager v2.9.0 -> canary(6%) (deploy id: d-20260311-17)

anya: good. what's the ramp and rollback criteria?

lina: ramp: 6% -> 30% in 12h if p95 <= baseline*1.5 -> 70% in 36h -> 100% in 72h. auto-rollback: errors > baseline*2 for 5m OR p95 > baseline*1.8 for 3m. manual rollback if dogfood flags quality regressions.

ops-bot: alert rule added: shortpath/us-west-2 p95 > baseline*1.5 -> notify @eng-oncall @eng-runtime. synthetic tests for currency/math prompts scheduled every 5m.

billing-bot: note: no changes to Dedicated billing; this only selects a different model variant inside shared runtime. informing enterprise-comms.

sylvia: can we get a Console tile for 'fastpath adoption' + projected savings per route? product wants a short blurb for Monday update.

lina: will add dashboard tile and short release note. action items: 1) finish extended evals for edge numeric cases (mo) 2) add console metric (lina) 3) monitor canary and synthetic alerts (ops) 4) prepare product blurb (sylvia). :rocket:

tarun: thanks team, excellent win. keep an eye on KV warmups during overnight traffic — last month we saw minor p99 spikes.

lina: noted. prefetch budget is capped to avoid memory pressure; we'll keep warmup synthetic checks running.

mo: thumbs up.

anya: :tada:
